meta.title: Optimize pytest startup via lazy runtime imports
meta.body_summary: Lazy-load JacMachine in meta_importer to avoid expensive import on Python startup, aiming to speed up pytest runs.

perf_labels.notes: Small lazy import refactor by OpenAI_Codex; tests listed as failures, no review interaction; closed without merge.
